einzeiler: Steven Spielberg shares rare stories about his complex friendship with Stanley Kubrick.
kurzfassung: Steven Spielberg recounts a quirky telephone exchange with Stanley Kubrick regarding a deleted scene from Dr. Strangelove. He describes Kubrick as a warm yet intensely curious figure who operated on his own terms. The preview sets the stage for a deep dive into the enigmatic director's life and personality in the upcoming season.
stichpunkte: Steven Spielberg asks Stanley Kubrick about a rumored deleted pie fight scene from Dr. Strangelove.
Kubrick deflects the question and instead asks Spielberg to acquire and send new radio microphones.
Spielberg personally purchases and ships two radio microphones to fulfill Kubrick's request.
Spielberg characterizes Kubrick as warm and sincere, yet resembling an otherworldly entity due to his active mind.
The unequal dynamic meant that whenever Kubrick made a request, Spielberg complied.
The upcoming season promises to explore the many layers and myths surrounding the legendary filmmaker.
beschreibung:
Steven Spielberg tells Ben Mankiewicz about the deal he struck with Stanley Kubrick for information about a famous cut scene from Dr. Strangelove.

Stanley, an eleven-episode limited series, begins September 24.
